name: dotnet-review

# Dotnet Review
Check async/cancellation, DI lifetime, exception handling, logging, auth, configuration, dependency versions, SQL calls, resilience policies, testing and performance. Use repo-local conventions and actual target frameworks; verify claims from code before recommending framework upgrades.

## Output
State observations, evidence, assumptions, prioritized actions, validation and human approval points. Do not claim actions or tests were completed unless tools actually ran.
